Since ¬Independent(J), the xor is true iff Collaborative(J)=T.
So the antecedent becomes simply Collaborative(J).

The consequent is Innovative(J), which we have shown is F.

This is equivalent to ¬Collaborative(J).
Hence Collaborative(J)=F; i.e., Jakob is not collaborative.
